local Bots={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Teams=game:GetService("Teams")
local Flags=require(script.Parent.FlagService)
local Brain=require(script.Parent.BotBrain)
local Avatar=require(script.Parent.AvatarService)
local Spawn=require(script.Parent.SpawnService)
local Damage=require(script.Parent.DamageService)
local Factory=require(script.Parent.WeaponFactory)
local template=game.ServerStorage.CTFBotTemplate
local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFBots") or Instance.new("Folder",workspace) folder.Name="CTFBots"
local bots={Blue={},Red={}} local respawn={Blue={},Red={}} local active=false local serial=0
local function alive(m) local h=m and m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") return m and m.Parent and h and h.Health>0 end
local function create(team,slot)
 serial+=1 local m=template:Clone() m.Name=team.Name.."_AI_"..serial
 m:SetAttribute("CTFBot",true) m:SetAttribute("CTFTeam",team.Name) m:SetAttribute("CTFSlot",slot)
 local role=slot<=2 and "Runner" or slot<=4 and "Soldier" or "Guardian"
 m:SetAttribute("CTFRole",role)
 m.Parent=folder
 local h=m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") h.MaxHealth=200 h.Health=200 h.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
 Avatar:Apply(m,slot+(team.Name=="Red" and 6 or 0),team)
 Spawn:Place(m,team)
 local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if root then pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end) end
 local tool=Factory:Create(role=="Runner" and "SMG" or role=="Soldier" and "Rifle" or "Sniper")
 tool.Parent=m h:EquipTool(tool)
 Damage:Watch(m)
 h.Died:Connect(function()
  Brain:Stop(m) Damage:Unwatch(m)
  Flags:DropCarrier(m) respawn[team.Name][slot]=os.clock()+7+math.random()*2
  task.delay(2.5,function() if m.Parent then m:Destroy() end end)
 end)
 task.spawn(function() Brain:Start(m,team,slot,Flags,function() return active end) end)
 return m
end
function Bots:Reconcile()
 if not active then return end
 for _,team in Teams:GetTeams() do
  local list=bots[team.Name] local humans=0
  for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do if p:GetAttribute("InMatch") and p.Team==team then humans+=1 end end
  local needed=math.max(0,6-humans)
  for slot=6,needed+1,-1 do if list[slot] then Flags:DropCarrier(list[slot]) Brain:Stop(list[slot]) Damage:Unwatch(list[slot]) list[slot]:Destroy() list[slot]=nil respawn[team.Name][slot]=0 end end
  for slot=1,needed do
   if not alive(list[slot]) and os.clock()>=(respawn[team.Name][slot] or 0) then
    if list[slot] then Brain:Stop(list[slot]) Damage:Unwatch(list[slot]) list[slot]:Destroy() end
    list[slot]=create(team,slot)
   end
  end
 end
end
function Bots:StartRound() active=true respawn={Blue={},Red={}} self:Reconcile() end
function Bots:StopRound()
 active=false
 for _,list in pairs(bots) do for slot=1,6 do if list[slot] then Flags:DropCarrier(list[slot]) Brain:Stop(list[slot]) Damage:Unwatch(list[slot]) list[slot]:Destroy() list[slot]=nil end end end
end
function Bots:GetCounts()
 local function count(list) local n=0 for _,m in pairs(list) do if alive(m) then n+=1 end end return n end
 return count(bots.Blue),count(bots.Red)
end
return Bots

local Damage={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Teams=game:GetService("Teams")
local Kits=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.KitDefinitions)
local Progress=require(game.ServerScriptService.Crossgrounds.ProgressionService)
local practice=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage.Events
local function remote(name)
 local r=events:FindFirstChild(name) or Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
 r.Name=name r.Parent=events return r
end
local feedback=remote("CombatFeedback")
local feed=remote("KillFeed")
local credits=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local watched=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
function Damage:Team(model)
 if not model then return end
 local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
 if p and p:GetAttribute("InArena") then return p.Team end
 if model:GetAttribute("CTFBot") then
  local team=model:GetAttribute("CTFTeam")
  if typeof(team)=="string" then return Teams:FindFirstChild(team) end
 end
end
function Damage:ShotRelation(attacker,model)
 if model==attacker then return "ignore" end
 local h=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h and h.Health<=0 then return "ignore" end
 local own=self:Team(attacker) local other=self:Team(model)
 if own and other==own then return "ignore" end
 if attacker:GetAttribute("AtLobby") and model:GetAttribute("PracticeDummy") then return "target" end
 return own and other and "target" or "block"
end
function Damage:ModelFromPart(part)
 local node=part
 while node and node~=workspace do
  if node:IsA("Model") and node:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return node end
  node=node.Parent
 end
end
local function name(model)
 local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
 return p and p.DisplayName or (model:GetAttribute("BotAlias") or model.Name).." · IA"
end
function Damage:Watch(model)
 local h=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not h or watched[h] then return end
 local watch={connections={},stopped=false} watched[h]=watch
 local health=h.Health local hurt=os.clock()
 table.insert(watch.connections,h.HealthChanged:Connect(function(v) if v<health then hurt=os.clock() end health=v end))
 task.spawn(function() while not watch.stopped and model.Parent and h.Health>0 do task.wait(1) if not watch.stopped and model.Parent and h.Health>0 and os.clock()-hurt>8 then h.Health=math.min(h.MaxHealth,h.Health+4) end end end)
 table.insert(watch.connections,h.Died:Connect(function()
  local team=Damage:Team(model)
  if not team then return end
  local victimPlayer=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
  if victimPlayer and victimPlayer:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and victimPlayer.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Deaths") then victimPlayer.leaderstats.Deaths.Value+=1 end
  local c=credits[h]
  local killer=c and os.clock()-c.time<=10 and c.model
  local killerTeam=killer and Damage:Team(killer)
  if killer and killerTeam and killerTeam~=team then
   local p=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(killer)
   local xp=p and Progress.CTFKill(p,model:GetAttribute("CTFBot")==true) or 0
   if p and p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Kills") then p.leaderstats.Kills.Value+=1 end
   local data=Kits.Weapons[c.weapon]
   feed:FireAllClients({killer=name(killer),victim=name(model),weapon=data and data.Name or c.weapon,killerTeam=killerTeam.Name,victimTeam=team.Name,headshot=c.headshot})
   if victimPlayer then feedback:FireClient(victimPlayer,{kind="Eliminated",character=model,killer=killer,killerName=name(killer),weapon=data and data.Name or c.weapon}) end
   if p then feedback:FireClient(p,{kind="Kill",victim=name(model),weapon=data and data.Name or c.weapon,xp=xp,headshot=c.headshot}) end
  else
   feed:FireAllClients({victim=name(model),victimTeam=team.Name,weapon="Eliminado"})
  end
  credits[h]=nil
 end))
end
function Damage:Practice(player,model,amount,weapon,headshot)
 if not model:GetAttribute("PracticeDummy") or not (amount>0 and amount<10000) then return false end
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 local record=practice[model] or {health=200,ready=0} practice[model]=record
 if now<record.ready then return false end
 record.health-=amount
 model:SetAttribute("PracticeMaxHealth",200) model:SetAttribute("PracticeHealth",math.max(0,record.health))
 local data=Kits.Weapons[weapon]
 if record.health<=0 then
  record.ready=now+3 record.health=200 model:SetAttribute("PracticeReadyAt",record.ready)
  local xp=Progress.Kill(player,"training",false)
  feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Kill",victim="Alvo de treino",weapon=data and data.Name or weapon,xp=xp,training=true,headshot=headshot})
  task.delay(3,function() if model.Parent and practice[model]==record then model:SetAttribute("PracticeHealth",200) model:SetAttribute("PracticeReadyAt",0) end end)
 else feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Hit",damage=math.floor(amount+.5),headshot=headshot}) end
 return true
end
function Damage:Unwatch(model)
 local h=model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") local watch=h and watched[h]
 if watch then watch.stopped=true for _,c in watch.connections do c:Disconnect() end watched[h]=nil end
 if h then credits[h]=nil end
end
function Damage:BreakProtection(model)
 if not model then return end
 model:SetAttribute("SpawnProtectedUntil",0)
 local shield=model:FindFirstChild("SpawnShield")
 if shield then shield:Destroy() end
end
function Damage:Deal(attacker,victim,amount,weapon,headshot)
 if not attacker or not attacker.Parent or not victim or victim.Health<=0 or not (amount>0 and amount<10000) then return false end
 local a=attacker:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local target=victim.Parent
 if not a or a.Health<=0 or not target or self:Team(attacker)==nil or self:Team(target)==nil or self:Team(attacker)==self:Team(target) then return false end
 if (target:GetAttribute("SpawnProtectedUntil") or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return false end
 self:Watch(target)
 credits[victim]={model=attacker,time=os.clock(),weapon=weapon,headshot=headshot}
 local actual=math.min(amount,victim.Health)
 victim:TakeDamage(amount)
 local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(attacker)
 if player then
  local root=target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  feedback:FireClient(player,{kind="Hit",damage=math.floor(actual+.5),headshot=headshot,position=root and root.Position})
 end
 return true
end
return Damage

ServerScriptService.MainGameScript.GameM:
local FlagService = {}
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local Config = require(game.ServerStorage.Configurations)
local Events = game.ReplicatedStorage.Events
local arena = workspace:WaitForChild("CTFInfrastructure")
local flags = {}
local connections = {}
local active = false
local alert=Events:FindFirstChild("CTFFlagAlert") or Instance.new("RemoteEvent") alert.Name="CTFFlagAlert" alert.Parent=Events
local function notify(flag,kind,character)
 local actor=character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
 local name=actor and actor.DisplayName or character and (character:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or character.Name) or ""
 for _,viewer in Players:GetPlayers() do
  if viewer:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf" and viewer:GetAttribute("InMatch") then
   alert:FireClient(viewer,{kind=kind,team=flag.team.Name,carrier=name,self=actor==viewer})
  end
 end
end
local function publish(flag)
 if not flag.base then return end
 flag.base:SetAttribute("FlagState",flag.state)
 local ref=flag.base:FindFirstChild("FlagCarrier") or Instance.new("ObjectValue") ref.Name="FlagCarrier" ref.Value=flag.carrier ref.Parent=flag.base
 local actor=flag.carrier and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(flag.carrier)
 flag.base:SetAttribute("FlagCarrierName",actor and actor.DisplayName or flag.carrier and (flag.carrier:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or flag.carrier.Name) or nil)
 flag.base:SetAttribute("FlagReturnAt",flag.state=="dropped" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+Config.FLAG_RESPAWN_TIME or 0)
end

local function actorInfo(character)
 if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then return nil end
 local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end
 local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
 if player and player:GetAttribute("InArena") then return player.Team, player, humanoid end
 if character:GetAttribute("CTFBot") then
  return Teams:FindFirstChild(character:GetAttribute("CTFTeam")), nil, humanoid
 end
 return nil
end

local function showFlag(flag, position)
 flag.pole.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0))
 flag.banner.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 1.7))
 flag.pole.Transparency = 0
 flag.banner.Transparency = 0
 flag.hitbox.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
 flag.hitbox.CanTouch = true
end

local function hideFlag(flag)
 flag.pole.Transparency = 1
 flag.banner.Transparency = 1
 flag.hitbox.CanTouch = false
end

local function clearCarry(flag)
 for _,c in flag.carryConnections or {} do c:Disconnect() end flag.carryConnections=nil
 if flag.carryVisual then flag.carryVisual:Destroy() flag.carryVisual = nil end
 if flag.carrier then flag.carrier:SetAttribute("CarryingFlag",nil) end
 flag.carrier = nil
end

function FlagService:Return(flag, silent)
 local wasAway = flag.state ~= "home"
 flag.returnToken += 1
 clearCarry(flag)
 flag.state = "home"
 showFlag(flag, flag.home)
 publish(flag)
 if active and wasAway and not silent then Events.ReturnFlag:Fire(flag.team.TeamColor) notify(flag,"return") end
end

function FlagService:DropCarrier(character)
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do
  if flag.carrier == character then
   local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local dropAt = root and root.Position or flag.home
   flag.returnToken += 1
   clearCarry(flag)
   flag.state = "dropped"
   notify(flag,"drop",character)
   publish(flag)
   showFlag(flag, Vector3.new(dropAt.X, math.max(dropAt.Y - 3, 13), dropAt.Z))
   local token = flag.returnToken
   task.delay(Config.FLAG_RESPAWN_TIME, function()
    if active and flag.state == "dropped" and token == flag.returnToken then
     self:Return(flag)
    end
   end)
  end
 end
end

local function carryFlag(flag, character, humanoid)
 flag.returnToken += 1
 flag.state = "carried"
 flag.carrier = character
 character:SetAttribute("CarryingFlag",flag.team.Name)
 publish(flag)
 hideFlag(flag)
 notify(flag,"pickup",character)
 local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then
  local pole = Instance.new("Part")
  pole.Name = "CarriedFlag"
  pole.Size = Vector3.new(.3, 4.5, .3)
  pole.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
  pole.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 205)
  pole.CanCollide = false
  pole.CanTouch = false
  pole.Massless = true
  pole.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.3, 1.8, .7)
  pole.Parent = character
  local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
  weld.Part0 = root weld.Part1 = pole weld.Parent = pole
  local banner = Instance.new("Part")
  banner.Name = "CarriedBanner"
  banner.Size = Vector3.new(.2, 1.7, 1.5)
  banner.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
  banner.Color = flag.banner.Color
  banner.CanCollide = false banner.CanTouch = false banner.Massless = true
  banner.CFrame = pole.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, .8)
  banner.Parent = pole
  local bannerWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
  bannerWeld.Part0 = pole bannerWeld.Part1 = banner bannerWeld.Parent = banner
  flag.carryVisual = pole
 end
 flag.carryConnections={humanoid.Died:Once(function() FlagService:DropCarrier(character) end),character.Destroying:Once(function() FlagService:DropCarrier(character) end)}
end

function FlagService:TryInteract(character)
 if not active then return end
 local team, player, humanoid = actorInfo(character)
 if not team then return end
 local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root then return end
 local own = flags[team.Name]
 if not own then return end
 local enemy
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do if flag.team ~= team then enemy = flag break end end
 if not enemy then return end
 local function near(a, b, radius)
  return (Vector3.new(a.X, 0, a.Z) - Vector3.new(b.X, 0, b.Z)).Magnitude <= radius and math.abs(a.Y-b.Y) < 12
 end
 if enemy.carrier == character and near(root.Position, own.home, 7) then
  if not Config.REQUIRE_RETURN_BEFORE_CAP or own.state == "home" then
   notify(enemy,"capture",character)
   self:Return(enemy, true)
   Events.CaptureFlag:Fire(player, team.TeamColor)
  end
  return
 end
 if own.state == "dropped" and near(root.Position, own.hitbox.Position, 6) then
  self:Return(own)
 end
 if enemy.state ~= "carried" and near(root.Position, enemy.hitbox.Position, 6) then
  carryFlag(enemy, character, humanoid)
 end
end

function FlagService:GetFlag(teamName)
 return flags[teamName]
end

function FlagService:Initialize()
 for _,c in connections do c:Disconnect() end connections={}
 for _,f in pairs(flags) do f.returnToken+=1 clearCarry(f) end flags={}
 arena=workspace:WaitForChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 for _, team in ipairs(Teams:GetTeams()) do
  local base = arena:WaitForChild(team.Name .. "Base")
  local stand = base:WaitForChild("FlagStand")
  local hitbox = base:FindFirstChild("FlagHitbox") or Instance.new("Part")
  hitbox.Name = "FlagHitbox"
  hitbox.Size = Vector3.new(7, 6, 7)
  hitbox.Transparency = 1
  hitbox.Anchored = true
  hitbox.CanCollide = false
  hitbox.CanQuery = false
  hitbox.Parent = base
  local flag = {
   base=base, team = team, stand = stand, pole = base.FlagPole, banner = base.FlagBanner,
   hitbox = hitbox, home = Vector3.new(stand.Position.X, stand.Position.Y - .5, stand.Position.Z),
   state = "home", returnToken = 0
  }
  flags[team.Name] = flag
  showFlag(flag, flag.home)
 publish(flag)
  local function touched(part)
   self:TryInteract(part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model"))
  end
  table.insert(connections,hitbox.Touched:Connect(touched))
  table.insert(connections,stand.Touched:Connect(touched))
 end
end

function FlagService:StartRound()
 active = true
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do self:Return(flag) end
end

function FlagService:StopRound()
 active = false
 for _, flag in pairs(flags) do self:Return(flag) end
end

return FlagService

-- World objective text is local to participants physically inside the active CTF map.
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
local arena local labels={} local elapsed=0 local added
local function track(obj)
 if (obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui")) and obj.Name=="FlagLabel" then table.insert(labels,obj) obj.Enabled=false end
end
local function refreshArena()
 local current=workspace:FindFirstChild("CTFInfrastructure")
 if current==arena then return end
 if added then added:Disconnect() added=nil end
 arena=current table.clear(labels)
 if arena then
  added=arena.DescendantAdded:Connect(track)
  for _,obj in arena:GetDescendants() do track(obj) end
 end
end
Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 elapsed+=dt if elapsed<.15 then return end elapsed=0 refreshArena()
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local h=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local visible=arena~=nil and root~=nil and h~=nil and h.Health>0
  and player:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode")=="ctf" and player:GetAttribute("InArena")==true

local Service={}
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local Sort=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Standings)
function Service:Start()
 if self.started then return end self.started=true
 local root=game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.Remotes
 local event=Instance.new("RemoteEvent") event.Name="Standings" event.Parent=root
 task.spawn(function() while true do
  local groups={arena={},ctf={},get_out={},duels={}}
  for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do
   local mode=p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") local group=groups[mode]
   if group and (mode~="ctf" or p:GetAttribute("InMatch")) then
    local stats=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    local function value(name) local v=stats and stats:FindFirstChild(name) return v and v.Value or 0 end
    local kills=mode=="arena" and (p:GetAttribute("ArenaKills") or 0) or value("Kills")
    table.insert(group,{userId=p.UserId,name=p.DisplayName,prestige=p:GetAttribute("Prestige_"..mode),kills=kills,deaths=mode=="arena" and (p:GetAttribute("ArenaDeaths") or 0) or value("Deaths"),score=mode=="arena" and kills or value("Captures")})
   end
  end
  for _,rows in groups do Sort.Sort(rows) end
  for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do local mode=p:GetAttribute("CrossgroundsMode") if groups[mode] then event:FireClient(p,{mode=mode,entries=groups[mode]}) end end
  task.wait(1)
 end end)
end
return Service
